title: Mara and the Hymn
author: Cyrus Delacroix
blurb: Quentin Okafor, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
